correctness.rationale: Solving affine pairwise equalities on the four quarter-intervals gives exactly the stated six ordered cells (ignoring null ties). Each cell maps linearly to entire cells, so each admissible cylinder maps bijectively onto its last cell with constant Jacobian. Thus even conditional on the previous symbol differing, the current point is uniform in the cell; the resulting Markov chain uses overlap length divided by twice the starting cell length. A first entrance back requires an initial string of self-loops, an exit, an excursion avoiding the target, and a final step back. The frozen five-state formula counts precisely these paths. Independently, if Aᵢ(z)=[(I−zP)⁻¹]ᵢᵢ, the positive-time unrestricted entrance series from state i is Uᵢ=(1−zPᵢᵢ)Aᵢ−1, subtracting the self transitions from all arrivals. By renewal at each actual entrance, Gᵢ=Uᵢ/(1+Uᵢ). A fresh exact symbolic cofactor calculation reconstructs P from interval intersections and matches all six rational functions and the derivative pairs (8,24), (12,188), (6,22). Finite irreducibility and nontrivial exit probability from each cell give exponential tails and justify the boundary |z|=1 and the finite moments. Entrance flux reciprocals give the same means; positive-integer geometric variances are 56, 132 and 30.
residual_risks: Only the stationary fair dyadic map, identity observable, unit lag and triples, with actual entries rather than every occupied time; null endpoints do not affect the probability model.

value.rationale: The fair doubling map and shortest ordinal window giving six order types are natural calibration choices for exact return statistics. The three rational functions resolve all delays, not just means, and their variance comparison shows markedly different departure from a matched geometric law in different cells. This gives an analytic benchmark for ordinal entry statistics with a verifiable distinction from plain visits.
residual_risks: No extrapolation to other lags, maps or observables, noisy series, or generally Markov ordinal coding.
